question: does U21.4's zone connection explain why the B.Cu GND pour never enters the 0.750 mm channel between U21's pad columns
answer: NO.  U21.4 stays alone on a 0.154 - 0.166 mm2 island in ALL FOUR arms, so the THERMAL SPOKE is not the binding constraint: KiCad's fill does not put copper in the channel at all.  The strip the zone's own 0.250 mm local_clearance leaves between the two pad columns is 0.251 mm against a 0.200 mm min_thickness and it is still not filled.  Widening it needs the ZONE's local clearance lowered board-wide, which trades every GND-to-foreign gap on the board for this one pad and is refused here.
